# Skill Harbor ⚓

> The Declarative Skill Setup & Orchestration Engine.

## Mission
Enable teams and individuals to **gain deep insights** into their skills, **refine and hone** them for project-specific needs, and **orchestrate** their distribution at scale. Skill Harbor is the intelligence infrastructure layer that makes sharing, managing, and optimizing engineering context seamless at both the local project and global fleet levels.

## Documentation Structure
- **[Introduction](https://docs.skill-harbor.app/introduction)**: Overview and core mission.
- **[Quickstart](https://docs.skill-harbor.app/quickstart)**: 3-step installation and first sync.
- **[Concepts: Skill Standards](https://docs.skill-harbor.app/concepts/skill-standards)**: Documentation on 'Ship Classes' (Dinghy -> Galleon) and harbor certified skill anatomy.
- **[Concepts: The Manifest & .harbor](https://docs.skill-harbor.app/concepts/manifest)**: Tracking, control, and management of the skill fleet.
- **[CLI Reference](https://docs.skill-harbor.app/reference/commands)**: Detailed guide for all commands (`up`, `fathom`, `voyager`, etc.).

## Commands
- `dock <url>`: Register a new skill in the manifest.
- `up`: The core sync engine — fetch, transpile, and berth skills into agent folders.
- `freshen`: Force-sync by bypassing local hash cache.
- `fathom`: Profile token displacement, heuristic confidence, sonar confidence, and contract alignment.
- `voyager`: End-to-end integration testing that simulates an agent loop with mocked tool calls.
- `lighthouse`: Generate a fleet intelligence prompt snippet for zero-tier discovery.
- `stow` / `unstow`: Back up and restore agent skills for lockdown governance.
- `check`: Verify berthed skills have valid metadata and integrity.
- `list`: Show all skills tracked in the manifest.
- `undock`: Purge berthed skills from agent folders.
- `migrate`: Move legacy root-level manifests into the `.harbor/` standard.

## Key Concepts
- **Three-Layer Manifests**: Global (`~/.harbor/`) > Project (`.harbor/`) > Local Override, merged with last-wins priority.
- **Multi-Platform**: Automatic distribution to Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Antigravity.
- **Semantic Contracts**: Skills declare `## Requires` and `## Produces` for validated chaining.
- **Ghost Discovery**: Detect unregistered skills in agent berths with `fathom --ghosts`.
- **Lockdown Governance**: Enforce manifest-only environments for sensitive projects.
